summary: Action required: update cluster Workload Identity Federation (WIF) configuration
description: Red Hat SRE has updated the required permissions for Workload Identity Federation (WIF) clusters. Please follow the documentation: https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_dedicated/4/html/openshift_dedicated_clusters_on_google_cloud/osd-creating-a-cluster-on-gcp-with-workload-identity-federation#wif-configuration-update_osd-creating-a-cluster-on-gcp-with-workload-identity-federation. Apply the new changes to your Workload Identity Federation (WIF) configuration with the command 'ocm gcp update wif-config'.
